== detail, auto-allocation on ==
div.bc-detail [data-build=paladin_hammerdin]
  p.bc-sum "Blessed Hammer from level 18 with Holy Shield and cheap gear. Slow early, then the sturdiest unattended caster. Hammers miss in corridors and drink mana."
  div.bc-pc
    div.bc-pros
      h4 "Pros"
      ul.bc-list-pros
        li "Almost nothing resists its damage"
        li "Very hard to kill with a shield"
        li "Scales to the end with cheap gear"
    div.bc-cons
      h4 "Cons"
      ul.bc-list-cons
        li "Weak and slow before level 18"
        li "Hammers miss in narrow corridors"
        li "Uses a lot of mana"
  h4 "Ratings (estimate)"
  ul.bc-rates.bc-rates-all [aria-label=All ratings]
    li.bc-r [data-rating=leveling]
      span.bc-rl "Leveling "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Leveling: 3 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★☆☆"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Slow before Blessed Hammer at 18"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=farmingItems]
      span.bc-rl "Farming (items) "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Farming (items): 5 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★★★"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Magic damage suits endless runs"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=farmingXP]
      span.bc-rl "Farming (XP) "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Farming (XP): 5 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★★★"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Dense areas give a lot of XP"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=bossing]
      span.bc-rl "Bossing "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Bossing: 4 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★★☆"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Fine single-target damage"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=defense]
      span.bc-rl "Defense "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Defense: 5 of 5 stars, estimate (Normal 5, Hell 4) role=img] "★★★★★"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Shield and block make it sturdy"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=clearSpeed]
      span.bc-rl "Clear speed "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Clear speed: 4 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★★☆"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Good clear, walking costs time"
    li.bc-r [data-rating=idle]
      span.bc-rl "Hands-off "
      span.bc-stars [aria-label=Hands-off: 3 of 5 stars, estimate role=img] "★★★☆☆"
      span.bc-rs " estimate"
      span.bc-rn " - Mana and corridors need watching"
  p.bc-diff "Defense by difficulty: Normal ★★★★★ (5 of 5), Hell ★★★★☆ (4 of 5)."
  h4 "Variants"
  ul.bc-vars
    li.bc-var [data-table=paladin-normal30 data-tier=supported]
      p.bc-vn "Leveling to level 30, earlier version"
      p.bc-vwhy "The first plan we wrote for levels one to thirty."
      details.bc-prev
        summary "First 2 levels"
        ul.bc-prev-list
          li "Level 2: Might"
          li "Level 6: Blessed Hammer x2 [unsupported], +5 str"
    li.bc-var [data-table=paladin-normal30-v2 data-tier=supported]
      p.bc-vn "Leveling to level 30 (recommended)"
      p.bc-vwhy "The plan for the first thirty levels, the one new heroes follow."
    li.bc-var [data-table=paladin_hammerdin_endgame90 data-tier=experimental]
      p.bc-vn "Full plan to level 90"
      p.bc-vwhy "The whole plan from level 30 up to level 90."
      p.bc-warn "Newer plan, less tested: skills it has not proven yet are saved for you to spend by hand."
      p.bc-warn "The hero cannot use these yet and will hold the point for you: Concentration."
      p.bc-note "1 more skill is not proven in the fighter yet."
  button.d-btn.bc-choose [data-variant=primary type=button] "Choose this build"
